Operations Director- Manufacturing
Jabil
Florence, KY
Jabil, Inc. is seeking a proven Operations Director to lead site operations and drive excellence across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and People. With oversight of Manufacturing, Quality, Safety, Test, Engineering, and Facilities, this leader will set operational strategy, develop high-performing teams, and ensure the organization has the capability and capacity to meet evolving customer demand. The Operations Director will also serve as a senior partner to Business Unit leadership and customers, driving continuous improvement and delivering sustainable operational results in a complex, high-mix, high-volume manufacturing environment.
What will you do?
Leadership and Organization
Lead the Operations Manager and all functional managers as direct reports, with a single point of accountability for Site performance across all shifts (24/7 operations).
Design and adjust the Site organization to support growth, ramps, and long-term site stability.
Hire, develop, and retain senior leaders. Work with Talent Acquisition on capability requirements and selection criteria for management roles.
Coach leaders on decision-making, performance management, and accountability.
Align manufacturing and the functions on shared priorities, and resolve conflicts between them.
Talent Development and Succession
Own succession planning and bench strength for critical leadership roles across the Site.
Track turnover, engagement, and organizational health, and put retention and development plans in place.
Make sure leadership development, training, and standard work are in place and working.
Build a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
Performance Management and Execution
Set site goals tied to Business Unit and Sr Leadership and cascade them through the organization.
Own the Site operating system: KPIs, dashboards, and tiered accountability reviews from the floor to site leadership.
Give timely, direct feedback to leaders based on performance data and what you see on the floor.
Make sure performance evaluations across the organization are accurate, fair, and on time.
Lead the site through ramps, escalations, and disruptions while keeping focus and discipline.
Business Strategy and Customer Alignment
Turn corporate and Business Unit strategy into executable site plans.
Align manufacturing, test, and support capacity with customer requirements, demand forecasts, and financial targets.
Represent the Site with customers in business reviews, audits, and escalations.
Update Business Unit and senior leadership regularly on performance, risks, and improvement initiatives.
Financial and Resource Management
Own the Site cost drivers (labor, overhead, and capital) and drive cost reduction and productivity improvements.
Approve and manage headcount plans, capacity models, and capital investments with Finance.
Make sure corrective actions are in place and tracked when cost, productivity, or delivery targets are missed.
Technical and Operational Excellence
Drive continuous improvement through data analysis, KPI management, and structured problem-solving (QRQC, RCA, Kaizen).
Make sure standard work, procedures, and work instructions are effective, current, and followed in every function.
Work with Engineering, Quality, and Test to improve process capability, yield, and customer satisfaction.
Promote best practices and share learnings with other Jabil sites.
Own Site compliance with Jabil policies, including Safety, Quality, Security, and Confidentiality, as well as regulatory and customer audits.
Set the tone for a strong safety culture and make sure all health and safety requirements are followed.
How will you get here?
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. Advanced degree preferred.
8-15 years of manufacturing or operations experience, including at least 7 years in a senior leadership role managing managers and multiple functions.
Hands-on leader who leads from the front and drives culture and change.
Experience in a complex, matrixed, fast-paced manufacturing environment (EMS preferred), including site ramps or large-scale growth.
Ability to influence customers, executives, and peers at all levels.
Strong safety mindset and a record of building a safety culture.
Working knowledge of operational metrics, labor and capacity planning, financial management, and continuous improvement tools.
Proficiency with Workday, SAP (ERP/MES), and Microsoft Office.
Willingness to be on the floor and flex across shifts as the business requires.

evidence.text:
Sr. Technical Program Manager - AI Manufacturing, Annapurna AI Manufacturing Quality and Reliability
Annapurna Labs
Austin, TX
Description
In Annapurna Labs we are at the forefront of hardware/software accelerator solutions for not only Amazon Web Services (AWS), but across the industry. The Annapurna AI Systems team owns design, validation, deployment, manufacturing, quality, reliability and fleet operations end to end.
Turning the silicon and systems into serving capacity is a manufacturing problem at a scale and pace the industry has not run before: cards, boards, sleds and servers built into racks across a global manufacturing footprint, then shipped to globally diverse datacenters and converted into capacity customers can launch on.
The Trainium Manufacturing, Quality and Reliability team owns that path end to end, and we looking for candidates interested in diving deep into our manufacturing, scaling and quality processes to support current and future generations of accelerator silicon/systems.
You will be responsible for managing server and rack manufacturing programs across our North America footprint — build plan attainment, rolled-through yield, test cycle time, work-in-process health and on-time shipment to datacenter — at ODM and CM sites.
We are seeking an experienced TPM who is equally comfortable on a factory floor and in a data set. You will reconcile what a partner reports, what the test data says, and what the design actually permits — and then drive the plan that closes the gap. Come join us!
Key job responsibilities
You will own manufacturing programs end to end across our ODM and CM partners: build rate against plan, rolled-through yield, first-pass test cycle time, aged work-in-process, and on-time shipment to datacenter.
You will establish the operating cadence with each partner — weekly build and recovery reviews, clear commitments, and an escalation path into vendor leadership that you are trusted to use.
You will own material readiness, operational support and constraint resolution — critical component supply, mechanical and enclosure quality, and staging capacity at each site. The job is to identify the constraint before it caps the build rate, and to drive the cross-functional plan that clears it.
You will drive manufacturing readiness for new rack platforms, defining entry and exit criteria for each build phase and gating ramp decisions on demonstrated yield and cycle time rather than on schedule pressure.
You will coordinate across Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Manufacturing Test, Quality and Reliability, Supply Chain, Global Supplier Management, Logistics and EC2. Manufacturing sits between design intent and deployed capacity.
You will build the reporting layer — define the metrics that describe manufacturing health, automate them where you can, and give senior leadership a clear weekly position on what shipped, what is at risk, what you need and by when.
You will work independently in a dynamic, challenging, and fast-changing organization. We’re changing an industry, and we need individuals who are ready for this challenge and who want to reach beyond what is possible today.
A day in the life
Your day to day responsibilities will include interfacing with our engineering teams, vendors and customers to understand project requirements and facilitate manufacturing output and scaling . You will work directly with vendors and ODM/JDM/CM teams to develop and manufacture your product at scale.
You will review build, yield and ship numbers from each site against plan and determine key bottlenecks and engage the right teams to overcome them. You will lead output and recovery reviews with ODM/CM leadership, pushing back on a commitment you do not believe the line can hold and landing on a number you can both defend. You will coordinate with vendor and Amazon supply chain teams to align materials with your build plans. You will write daily/weekly reports as necessary to inform leadership on the current state and key challenges.
About The Team
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future. We care about growing the people on this team — the work is genuinely hard, the feedback is direct and kind, and nobody here is short of problems worth solving.
Basic Qualifications
5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience working with cross-geographic vendors in the ODM/CM model
Experience owning manufacturing or operations metrics — yield, cycle time, throughput or work-in-process — and driving measurable improvement
Preferred Qualifications
5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

Director of Manufacturing Operations Description
Our client in the manufacturing industry is looking for a Director of Manufacturing Operations to join their team in East Dallas, near Mesquite, TX. This newly created role will lead approximately 40 employees across production, supply chain, inventory, quality, and continuous improvement, through three direct report managers. You will build the operating systems needed to support continued growth, with an emphasis on improving production flow, standardizing work, strengthening material availability, and reducing order-to-ship lead times. The operation is low-volume, high-mix, and highly customized, making experience applying lean principles in complex manufacturing environments critical. Our client is looking for a manufacturing leader who has led multiple functions and personally delivered measurable improvements from batch production toward flow. This is an opportunity to build and improve an operating system while leading a growing manufacturing organization in a high-demand market.

Lead production, supply chain, inventory, quality, and facilities
Develop production flow, capacity, scheduling, and standard work systems
Reduce order-to-ship lead times and improve on-time delivery
Build material replenishment, point-of-use, and inventory systems
Improve supplier performance, sourcing, material availability, and lead times
Move quality controls upstream to reduce defects reaching final testing
Establish daily management and structured problem-solving systems
Lead lean improvements across low-volume, high-mix production
Develop operations leaders and an approximately 40-person team
Build capacity to support growth without proportional labor or space increases
Director of Manufacturing Operations Qualifications
10+ years of manufacturing operations experience required
5+ years leading multiple manufacturing departments, including production, required
Low-volume, high-mix or complex assembly experience required
Experience leading production flow improvements or measurable lead-time reduction required
Experience implementing and sustaining lean management practices in manufacturing required
Experience scaling production capacity or output required
Manufacturing ERP proficiency required

Job Description:
Are you an experienced aerospace quality leader with an active A&P certification
ready to drive operational perfection? Airbus Helicopters, Inc. is seeking a strategic, results-driven Quality Assurance Manager
to direct quality compliance, continuous improvement, and operational execution across our Blades, Dynamic Component Repair (DCR), NDT, and Tail Boom operations in Texas.
In this high-impact role, you will lead a dedicated team of 13 QA inspectors, championing a zero-escape culture, right-first-time quality, and Lean manufacturing principles. You will serve as a key leader shaping departmental budgets, guiding career development, and maintaining rigorous compliance with FAA, AS9100, EASA, and global regulatory standards.
Meet The Team:
From building to servicing the next generation of aerospace, our team focuses on quality, productivity and efficiency. We ensure the highest quality of care and safety is built into each aircraft we assemble and maintain. Our team members make it happen
Your working environment:
A suburb just outside the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area is home to Airbus Helicopters U.S. regional headquarters, where we have more than 1,000 employees. Check out one of the seven professional sports teams that also call Dallas home - you may even see a special, custom Airbus helicopter dedicated to the Dallas Cowboys flying during home games.
How we care for you:
Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.
Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
Your Challenges:
Manage Department: 45%
Provide leadership, vision, and strategic planning for inspectors. Provide clear daily, weekly, monthly and annual goals for inspectors based on TCOs, Internal customer priorities and Operational Quality KPIs.
Establish and Maintain departmental OPEX and CAPEX budgets and Top Company Objectives (TCO) and AHNA goals.
Oversee the Quality Management system for procedural compliance and internal/external audits.
Lead staff to enhance their career development and build a collaborative team.
Accountable for the Operational Quality of DCR, Blades and NDT by ensuring KPIs are in place to actively monitor and manage product flow and eliminate any backlog.
Accountable for the management of NCs issued in the department by ensuring timely disposition of NCs and effective root cause and corrective actions are completed by stakeholders.
Manage employee time and vacation with care to not impact business operations and backlogs.
Lead Inspectors: 35%
Develop and sustain a team of Inspectors trained in customer Quality Airbus and Regulatory competency requirements for DCR, Blades and Equipment requirements. Also, responsible for ensuring that special processes such as Non Destructive Inspection are compliant AH/AHD, ASNT and EN standards
Ensure inspectors comply with FAA, AS9100, CASE, Transport Canada (TC), UK CAA and EASA requirements.
Sustain processes for compliance with FAA, TC, UK and EASA airworthiness issuance with federal regulations. - This is similar to the one above. I would prefer to keep this one also. I made an update as this is intended to ensure our processes meet regulatory requirements, the prior bullet is for personnel.
Ensure all inspectors work to the Airbus Code of Conduct, Code of Ethics and Airbus Safety standards.
Identify and drive YourSay improvement in the department.
Improve Quality Processes: 20%
Lead, mentor and support projects for implementing digital documentation systems including electronic signatures.
Monitor Andon and Quality Gate processes to ensure a zero escape culture and measure the First Pass Yields at key process stages and take appropriate and timely actions to improve First Pass Yield.
Integrate Airbus Group’s problem solving tools such as PDCA and PPS, into AHNA Regional activities to resolve supplier, internal, and customer non Quality drivers
Use data to identify inefficiencies in the process and implement process improvements focussed on Quantitative Efficiencies and Right First Time Quality.
Your Boarding Pass: (Required for consideration)

Ten (10) or more years in the aerospace industry
Five (5) or more years in a management role
MUST HAVE a valid, current Airframe and Powerplant License
Extensive knowledge of aerospace industry, helicopter MRO components and special processes
Ability to lead and direct complex assignments.
Ability to manage cost and schedule for large $1M+ projects.
Ability to lead teams effectively.
Strong facilitation and strategy skills.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and able to react to shifting priorities to meet business needs.
Travel Required:
20% Domestic and International
Citizenship:
Authorized to Work in the US without current of future need for visa sponsorship
Physical Requirements:
Onsite or remote: 80% Onsite in Grand Prairie, TX when not on travel

Several times per day

Administrative position only PPE required: Steel-toed shoes are required for all shop floor visits, appropriate hearing/eye protection may also be required when visiting the shop floor.

evidence.text:
SAP - Production Planning - Digital Manufacturing Cloud - Senior Manager-Consulting - Location OPEN
EY
Huntsville, AL
Location: Anywhere in Country
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
Our objective is to provide clients with a distinctive business perspective on leveraging SAP technology, particularly within the Digital Manufacturing Cloud (DMC), to enhance their operational efficiency. This is grounded in the EY SAP service line capabilities (Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer, Tech/Arch, and SuccessFactors) aimed at improving performance and productivity.
The opportunity
We innovate with SAP to co-create more innovative answers, drawing on our integrated competencies in tax, assurance, transactions, and risk, as well as our work in implementing SAP. Together, we help clients provide better outcomes and long-lasting results, from strategy to execution. We take a comprehensive, business-first view to address strategy, customer value, user experiences, processes, technology, and operational impacts in tandem. Our SAP Manufacturing professionals deliver strategic solutions to help clients transform their manufacturing operations improving cost, efficiency, quality, and effectiveness.
As a Senior Manager in our Technology practice, you will play a pivotal role in interacting with business stakeholders to evaluate and analyze business models, processes, and operations specifically related to DMC. You will translate business requirements into technical specifications and ensure that newly implemented technology solutions meet these requirements. Your collaboration with technical teams will be crucial in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.
Your Key Responsibilities
In this role, you will manage and deliver complex processes and solutions while maintaining a strong focus on quality and risk management. You will face challenges that require innovative problem-solving and analytical skills, allowing you to grow your expertise in technology analysis and implementation. Your responsibilities will include:
Lead engagement delivery and manage client relationships daily, focusing on DMC-related initiatives.
Oversee program/project management, ensuring engagement economics are met while delivering DMC solutions.
Develop resource plans and budgets for complex engagements, particularly those involving DMC.
Lead large-scale SAP client engagements or work streams with a focus on DMC, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
Demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities within DMC and maintain strong business acumen, staying updated on industry trends relevant to clients.
Consistently deliver high-quality client services by monitoring progress, managing risks, and keeping stakeholders informed of developments and expected outcomes.
Build and maintain relationships with client personnel at all levels to foster collaboration and trust in EY SAP DMC initiatives.
Effectively lead and motivate diverse teams, providing constructive feedback and coaching while fostering an innovative and inclusive work environment.
Identify and generate new business opportunities by understanding EY’s service lines and proactively assessing ways to meet client needs in the DMC space.
Skills And Attributes For Success
On your typical engagement, you will work with the key stakeholders to understand their needs and advise on SAP DMC capabilities. You will initiate the requirement gathering, architect solutions, blueprinting, testing, and complete the workflow and documentation, as well as the functional design of the DMC solution. Liaise with the stakeholders and technical team to translate needs into business solutions and complete the configurations and/or integrations with SAP and non-SAP systems.
To thrive in this role, you will need a blend of technical and interpersonal skills that will allow you to build strong relationships and deliver exceptional results. Key skills include:
Strong technical skills in application functional design and technology business requirements definition specific to DMC.
Proven ability to analyze and map technology cost-benefit scenarios related to DMC implementations.
Expertise in system configuration design and business architecture frameworks within the Digital Manufacturing Cloud space.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and negotiate effectively.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A Bachelor’s degree; a Master’s degree is preferred.
Typically, 5 - 7 years of relevant experience.
At least five (5) years of experience in SAP Production Planning (PP) specifically within Digital Manufacturing Cloud (DMC).
Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
Proven experience managing SAP projects or work streams, including oversight of project-based team members on shore and offshore.
Proficient in supply chain best practices, particularly within the context of Digital Manufacturing Cloud (DMC), complemented by extensive benchmarking and advisory experience in supply chain-specific technology functions.
Ability and comfort-level researching client inquiries and emerging issues, including regulations, industry practices and new technologies.
A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.
Experience in conducting technology cost-benefit analyses.
Familiarity with technology business architecture frameworks.
Skills in training design and delivery.
Ideally, you’ll also have
Prior consulting industry experience with DMC specialization.
SAP certification(s).
Experience as a workstream/team lead for manufacturing with SAP.
Experience with at least two full lifecycle implementations of SAP ERP (ECC and/or S/4HANA) specifically working with the SAP Production Planning (PP) module implementing Digital Manufacturing Cloud.
Experience with at least one full lifecycle implementation with SAP Material Requirement Planning (MRP).
Experience integrating SAP PP with a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) SAP Quality Management (QM), SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), and SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud (DMC).
Experience performing hands-on SAP system configuring in PP.
Experience designing custom RICEF solutions and writing functional specifications.
Experience writing and executing test scripts.
Experience writing and delivering training materials for end users.
Knowledge of integration between SAP PP and:
FICO for product costing and order settlement
Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) for production supply and receiving
PPDS
Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, including ownership of Bills of Material (BOM)
Master Data Management (MDM) tools/systems for manufacturing data
Materials Management, for both Inventory Management and Procurement functions
Digital Manufacturing Cloud, for both Discrete and Process Industries
Knowledge of manufacturing operations, preferably in complex industrial. equipment (or similar) and assembly line operations.
Knowledge of product lifecycle management, including Engineering BOMs and Manufacturing BOMs.
Experience with both Make to Stock and Make/Engineer/Configure to Order business models.
What We Look For
We seek individuals who are not only skilled in their technical domain but also possess the qualities of leadership, collaboration, and innovation. Top performers are those who can navigate complex challenges with agility and drive impactful results through their strategic thinking and interpersonal skills.
What We Offer You
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $171,600 to $392,100. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $205,900 to $445,700. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. evidence.text:
Director of Trade Compliance & Quality
Zhone Technologies Inc
Largo, FL
Description
The Director of Trade Compliance & Quality leads Zhone’s global trade compliance program and supports the development and implementation of the company’s Quality Management System.
The primary responsibility of this position is Trade Compliance. The successful candidate must have extensive, hands-on experience managing U.S. and international import/export compliance in a global business environment, including export controls, customs, product classification, sanctions and restricted-party screening, licensing, regulatory documentation, and international shipping requirements.
The role provides subject-matter expertise and practical guidance to Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, Sales, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to help ensure Zhone products and transactions comply with applicable trade laws and regulatory requirements.
As a secondary but strategically important responsibility, the Director leads Zhone’s Quality Management System initiatives, with the objective of achieving and subsequently maintaining ISO 9001 and TL 9000 certification.
The position requires a practical, hands-on leader capable of developing policies and procedures, resolving complex compliance matters, preparing the organization for audits and certifications, and working effectively with suppliers, contract manufacturers, customers, regulatory authorities, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and certification bodies.
Key Responsibilities
Trade Compliance - Primary Responsibility
Lead and continuously improve Zhone’s global import and export compliance program.
Interpret and apply applicable U.S. and international trade laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ITAR where applicable, U.S. Customs requirements, sanctions requirements, and FCC-related regulatory considerations.
Manage classification of products, components, software, and technology using Export Control Classification Numbers (ECCNs) and Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classifications.
Determine export authorization and licensing requirements and manage applicable export licenses and import permits.
Manage denied-party, restricted-party, sanctions, embargo, and country-of-destination compliance.
Review transactions involving controlled or potentially restricted technologies, customers, countries, suppliers, end users, and end uses.
Provide guidance on the handling and transfer of export-controlled technical information and technology.
Establish and maintain trade compliance policies, procedures, work instructions, records, and internal controls.
Ensure accurate customs, import/export, and international shipping documentation.
Support proper determination and documentation of country of origin, customs valuation, tariff classification, and applicable trade requirements.
Support compliance associated with global sourcing, contract manufacturing, product transfers, and changes in manufacturing location.
Monitor regulatory developments, assess business impact, and implement required process and documentation changes.
Conduct or coordinate periodic trade compliance audits and risk assessments.
Develop and deliver role-appropriate trade compliance training.
Maintain documentation needed for internal audits, external audits, disclosures, and regulatory inquiries.
Investigate and resolve complex or escalated trade compliance matters.
Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders, suppliers, customers, regulatory authorities, and external trade counsel, as appropriate.
Partner with Engineering to obtain the technical information necessary for defensible product classifications and regulatory assessments.
Provide practical compliance guidance that supports business execution while maintaining appropriate regulatory controls.
Quality Management - Secondary Responsibility
Lead Zhone’s initiative to achieve and maintain ISO 9001 and TL 9000 certification.
Develop, implement, and maintain an effective company-wide Quality Management System (QMS).
Conduct gap assessments against ISO 9001 and TL 9000 requirements and establish a prioritized certification-readiness roadmap.
Develop and maintain quality policies, procedures, work instructions, records, and document-control requirements.
Establish and coordinate the internal quality audit program and QMS management reviews.
Manage or oversee nonconformities, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), root-cause analysis, and verification of corrective-action effectiveness.
Establish and monitor quality performance indicators and applicable TL 9000 measurements.
Coordinate quality requirements with Zhone’s ODM, EMS, component, and other manufacturing partners.
Support supplier qualification, supplier performance monitoring, supplier corrective actions, and quality audits, as appropriate.
Coordinate with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Customer Support on product and process quality matters.
Lead preparation for certification and surveillance audits and serve as a primary interface with certification bodies.
Ensure audit findings and nonconformities are appropriately investigated, documented, corrected, and closed.
Drive continuous improvement using quality data, customer feedback, product returns, manufacturing issues, field performance, and supplier performance.
Requirements
Education
Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, International Trade, Engineering, Quality, or a related discipline preferred.
An equivalent combination of relevant education and substantial trade compliance experience may be considered.
Trade Compliance
8+ years of progressive, hands-on trade compliance experience, preferably within telecommunications, networking equipment, electronics, technology, or another international hardware business.
Extensive working knowledge of the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR).
Demonstrated experience performing or managing ECCN classifications.
Strong experience with HTS classification and U.S. Customs requirements.
Experience determining export licensing and authorization requirements.
Demonstrated experience with sanctions, embargo, end-use/end-user, and restricted-party compliance.
Experience managing international import/export documentation and regulatory records.
Experience working with freight forwarders, customs brokers, suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to assess regulatory and operational risk and resolve complex trade compliance matters.
Experience developing or maintaining trade compliance policies, procedures, internal controls, training, and audit programs, and translating regulations into practical business processes and documented decisions.
Ability to interpret technical product information and collaborate with Engineering on regulatory classifications.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex regulations in clear business terms and influence and collaborate across Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, Sales, Finance, Legal, and executive management.
Ability to work effectively with customers, suppliers, manufacturing partners, auditors, and regulatory authorities.
High attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate, audit-ready compliance and quality records and supporting documentation.
Strong Microsoft Excel and data-analysis capabilities; experience with ERP systems and trade-compliance or classification tools is preferred.
Quality
Practical experience working within an ISO 9001 Quality Management System.
Familiarity with QMS documentation, internal audits, management reviews, certification readiness, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
Experience supporting or leading an ISO certification or surveillance audit is strongly preferred.
Previous TL 9000 experience is highly desirable.
Experience with quality management in telecommunications, electronics manufacturing, ODM/EMS, or another technology-hardware environment is preferred.
Familiarity with 5 Whys, 8D, Fishbone/Ishikawa analysis, Pareto analysis, and FMEA is desirable.
Recommended Professional Certifications
Trade Compliance - Certifications Strongly Preferred
Certified Export Specialist (CES), NCBFAA Educational Institute.
Certified Customs Specialist (CCS), NCBFAA Educational Institute.
U.S. Customs Broker License, highly desirable.
Additional recognized training or credentials covering EAR/export controls, sanctions, customs, and international trade compliance.
Quality - Certifications Preferred
ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer training.
TL 9000 training.
ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA).
ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE).
ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE).

evidence.text:
Senior Manager, Quality Engineering - Manufacturing Operations
Edwards Lifesciences
Salt Lake City, UT
Innovation starts from the heart. Edwards Lifesciences is the leading global structural heart innovation company, driven by a passion to improve patient lives. With millions of patients served in over 100 countries, each team makes a meaningful contribution by improving patient outcomes and discovering lasting solutions for unmet patient needs. Our Senior Manager, Quality Engineering
position is a unique career opportunity that could be your next step towards an exciting future.
The Senior Manager, Quality Engineering is a people leadership and manufacturing role responsible for providing quality and compliance oversight. This leader will manage and develop a team of Quality Engineers while partnering closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Facilities, Maintenance, and Supply Chain to ensure manufacturing activities are performed safely, effectively, and in compliance with applicable quality system requirements.
The position will oversee quality and compliance activities supporting the plant’s major production areas, including THV manufacturing, TMTT manufacturing, advanced catheters, and metals. The successful candidate will strengthen NCR and CAPA execution, improve investigation quality, monitor operational quality metrics, and establish effective communication and continuity.
How You'll Make an Impact:
Lead, coach, and develop a team of Quality Engineers supporting manufacturing operations, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and individual development plans.
Provide quality and compliance oversight for manufacturing activities, ensuring operations are performed in accordance with approved procedures, quality system requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
Oversee the initiation, investigation, review, approval, and timely closure of nonconformance reports, including evaluating investigation quality, root cause determination, corrective actions, and product or process risk.
Own and provide leadership for CAPAs, including investigation strategy, root cause analysis, action planning, implementation, effectiveness verification, and sustainable closure.
Lead the deployment, implementation, and continuous improvement of quality management systems and manufacturing quality processes aligned with ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820.
Review and approve test method validations, measurement system analyses, and manufacturing process validations, including IQ, OQ, and PQ documentation.
Monitor quality metrics, trends, investigation performance, and quality data reviews; identify emerging risks and provide actionable recommendations to Operations and Quality leadership.
Support internal and external audits by ensuring operations remain inspection-ready, responding to auditor questions, and leading or supporting actions resulting from audit observations.
Partner with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Manufacturing, Facilities, Maintenance, and Supply Chain to resolve quality issues, maintain compliant production, and strengthen operational controls.
Establish effective shift-to-shift communication and escalation processes to ensure timely transfer of quality, production, and compliance information.
Provide quality leadership for supplier-related issues, as applicable, including investigation support, corrective actions, and supplier performance concerns.
Promote a culture of quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and proactive risk management.
Develop and implement quality processes that improve product compliance, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
Other incidental duties as assigned.
What You'll Need (Required):
Bachelor’s degree with relevant Quality Engineering, Quality Management, or Manufacturing Quality experience within a highly regulated environment; or equivalent experience based on Edwards’ criteria.
Demonstrated people leadership experience managing and developing engineers or other technical quality professionals.
Experience deploying, implementing, or sustaining quality management systems within a regulated manufacturing environment, including working knowledge of ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820 requirements.
Strong experience leading CAPAs, nonconformance investigations, and structured root cause analysis, including evaluation of investigation quality and effectiveness.
What Else We Look For (Preferred):
Engineering or Scientific degree
Medical device manufacturing experience
Experience providing quality oversight for manufacturing or production operations, including partnering directly with Operations and Engineering to resolve compliance and product quality issues.
Demonstrated ability to interpret quality data, monitor operational quality metrics, recognize adverse trends, and escalate significant risks.
Experience with microbiology principles or microbiological controls in a regulated manufacturing environment.
Experience supporting cleanroom qualification, environmental controls, or manufacturing operations performed within controlled environments.
Supplier quality or supplier management experience, including supplier investigations and corrective actions.
Experience reviewing or approving test method validations and measurement system analysis studies.
Experience reviewing or approving manufacturing process validations, including IQ/OQ/PQ.
Experience supporting internal, external, or regulatory audits.
Experience leading quality activities across multiple manufacturing technologies, product lines, or production areas.
Knowledge of statistical methods, process capability, measurement systems, risk management, and continuous improvement tools.
Demonstrated success strengthening team capability, improving organizational effectiveness, and leading change within a manufacturing quality organization.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence decisions and communicate effectively across technical, operational, and leadership audiences.
Edwards is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer including protected Veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Head of Manufacturing
Powertown
Boston, Massachusetts
Overview
We need someone who has taken hardware from a successful first unit to repeatable, high-volume manufacturing, and who wants to build that function from scratch. You'll own everything between "the engineering team built one that works" and "we can build hundreds of these reliably, on schedule, at cost."
What You'll Do
Own the transition from prototype builds to scaled Powerblock production, standing up the manufacturing function from the ground up
Develop equipment, fixtures, and processes for early-stage builds and design them to scale into high-volume production
Determine and procure manufacturing equipment, working with integrators on semi-automated through fully automated systems as volume justifies it
Manage suppliers through specification, design, buyoff, and installation of manufacturing equipment
Provide DFM input back to the hardware team to improve yield and manufacturability as the Powerblock design matures
Create manufacturing instructions and documentation to train the technicians who'll build production units
Set the cost, quality, and throughput targets that let us hit our per-unit hardware cost goals at scale
What You'll Bring
5+ years hands-on as a Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Design Engineer on mechanical or electromechanical systems, ideally with time spent taking a product from prototype to volume production
2D CAD for line design (AutoCAD) and 3D CAD for equipment, fixturing, and tooling (SolidWorks or CATIA)
Experience with conveyance, workstation design, robotic systems, adhesive dispensing, DC fastening tools, or automated functional test
GD&T and system stack-up analysis
Experience writing technical specifications for automated manufacturing equipment
DFM and DFA experience, and comfort giving that input directly to a hardware design team
Comfort operating with almost no existing infrastructure. You're building the manufacturing function, not stepping into one.

Background in battery, energy storage, or power electronics hardware
Experience standing up a manufacturing line at an early-stage hardware startup

items.title: Engineering Manager – Stamping Equipment - Laser Development

evidence.quote: 7+ years of experience building and owning production systems, including experience hiring and leading engineering teams.
evidence.text:
Head of Engineering
Stealth Startup
Boston, MA
$170,000.00/yr - $210,000.00/yr
Head of Engineering – AI & Healthcare Technology
What You'll Own
AI Systems and Engineering Leverage
Own how the company uses AI models, including model selection, deployment, and cost optimization. Continuously improve the product as models evolve, using less expensive models where they meet the required quality standards.
Build evaluation frameworks and quality feedback loops to demonstrate, with evidence, whether documentation is accurate, complete, and consistent, and whether new capabilities are ready for real-world clinical practices.
Empower engineers and non-engineers to build and ship products using the best available AI models and development tools. Continuously improve team workflows as these tools advance, while maintaining high standards for the quality and security of customer-facing releases.
Systems and Delivery
Own end-to-end R&D delivery, translating ambiguous customer needs into reliable, production-ready software for a growing multi-tenant healthcare platform.
Standardize phone system integrations to make onboarding new medical practices faster, more efficient, and repeatable.
Maintain exceptionally high standards for correctness and data integrity across integrations with Electronic Health Records (EHRs), telephony systems, and third-party APIs.
Understand and optimize the complete cost of product delivery, including telephony, transcription, and AI model usage, while designing for sustainable unit economics.
Reliability and Security
Improve system reliability through robust observability, alerting, incident response processes, and deployment pipelines.
Build security and compliance into the platform by default, including HIPAA compliance, encryption, and auditability, and establish standards for the engineering team to follow.
Technical Leadership
Define the team's technical direction and build alignment around architectural decisions and engineering priorities.
Hire exceptional engineers who raise the bar and foster a culture that combines AI-driven ambition with rigorous quality standards.
Improve engineering capabilities through code reviews, design discussions, and collaborative programming.
Partner with clinical and product stakeholders to translate requirements into sound, scalable technical solutions.
Customer Empathy and Product Excellence
Understand how nurses, healthcare providers, and practice staff rely on the platform in their daily workflows. Identify gaps, prioritize improvements, and ensure solutions are delivered effectively.
Pay close attention to user experience details, including presenting information more clearly, reducing unnecessary clicks, and making the next action intuitive.
Represent the customer's perspective within the engineering organization, ensuring the team remains focused on the people and workflows the product serves.
What Good Looks Like
You bring energy and urgency to the work, helping the team tackle meaningful and challenging problems every day.
Each new generation of AI models improves the product, and adopting new models becomes a routine process rather than requiring a major rebuild.
Product documentation quality is measured with evidence, and new capabilities reach customers only after meeting established quality standards.
A small engineering team delivers an exceptional amount of work because AI is embedded throughout its development processes.
New medical practices are onboarded through standardized, repeatable integrations, allowing the platform to scale across more practices and enterprise customers without compromising reliability or security.
The cost of delivering the product decreases as usage grows.
Engineers continuously improve through your feedback, standards, and established engineering practices, while new hires further strengthen the team.
The CEO and the wider team trust you to make critical technical decisions, allowing others to focus on their respective priorities.
What We're Looking For
Must Have
7+ years of experience building and owning production systems, including experience hiring and leading engineering teams.
Hands-on experience building with Large Language Models (LLMs), not just building infrastructure around them. You have shipped LLM-powered features to production and managed post-launch challenges such as evaluation, quality drift, latency, and cost.
Strong awareness of the latest AI developments. You actively experiment with new models and agentic tools, have a clear perspective on their future direction, and can distinguish genuine technological breakthroughs from hype.
AI-first engineering practices. You use AI coding tools and agents daily and have transformed how a team works through improved workflows, tooling, code reviews, and task ownership.
Experience making architectural decisions that hold up under real-world conditions and designing systems that improve as AI models evolve, without requiring a complete rebuild with every release.
Exceptional software engineering fundamentals and experience designing large-scale systems, combined with a strong understanding of how AI changes team responsibilities and software development practices.
Ability to work autonomously in fast-moving, ambiguous environments while bringing clarity, alignment, and momentum to the wider team.
Experience joining an existing team and codebase, earning credibility with established engineers, and raising standards through influence, practical contributions, and effective processes.
Strong Signals
Experience in healthcare, fintech, or other regulated industries, with familiarity with compliance requirements such as HIPAA, encryption, and auditability.
Experience with real-time voice systems, including telephony, streaming audio, speech-to-text, or WebSockets.
Experience building integrations with EHRs or other complex third-party systems and making those integrations standardized and repeatable.
Who This Role Is Not For
You prefer managing from a distance and leaving architecture, development processes, and the quality of customer-facing releases to others.
You measure success by the number of people reporting to you.
You expect a fully researched Product Requirements Document (PRD) for every change rather than taking ownership of a problem and driving it forward.
You view AI as just another roadmap feature or prefer waiting for tools and best practices to stabilize before adopting them.
You are excited about the newest AI models but not about the work required to make them reliable for clinicians during live calls.
You want to focus exclusively on technical challenges while leaving customer problems and pain points to others.
Compensation
Base Salary:
Competitive compensation for a seed-stage healthcare technology company.
Equity:
Early-stage equity grant, offering the opportunity to join early and help build the engineering organization from the ground up.

evidence.quote: Significant leadership experience in enterprise quality or quality assurance, across in-house and vendor/partner-based delivery.
evidence.text:
Vice President, Enterprise Quality & Automation
SS&C Technologies
Atlanta, GA
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.
Job Description
Vice President, Enterprise Quality & Automation
Locations: Atlanta, GA, Jacksonville, FL, Fort Worth, TX
About The Role
As Vice President of Enterprise Quality & Automation, you will own the quality our clients and operations actually experience across pharmacy and medical — from requirements and vendor execution through UAT, release readiness, defect management, automation, and AI enablement.
Quality isn't produced by any single team. It takes shape across the entire delivery process. This leader works across Product, Technology, Operations, and vendors to set quality standards, surface risk early, and align everyone toward shared outcomes. The VP will also help define how far this capability should go, from strengthening quality today, to establishing a durable operating model, to evolving quality, automation, and testing into scalable commercial offerings over time. The path is not fully defined by design: we want a leader who is energized by ambiguity and eager to shape the strategy and roadmap rather than inherit them. This role reports into the SVP, Operations, and will build and lead a team of four to six direct reports at the Director level. The leader will help shape how that team is structured and grows over time.
Why Join SS&C
SS&C combines proprietary technology with deep industry expertise to support complex financial and health care operations. Our teams design, implement, and operate solutions that help clients manage data, automate processes, and scale their businesses with confidence.
You will work with industry experts, modern platforms, and evolving technologies, gaining exposure to real-world operational challenges and large-scale enterprise environments.
What Makes This Role Different
A mandate to shape the function. You will build and lead a team of four to six and shape its structure and operating model as the strategy takes shape. A rare chance to design a capability rather than inherit one.
Real influence across the enterprise. You are the trusted voice on quality across Product, Technology, Operations, and vendors; setting standards, surfacing risk, and driving decisions at the executive level, with the visibility and mandate to make quality a priority.
AI and automation are central. These are major parts of the strategy, from predictive quality analytics and defect prediction to release-risk assessment and intelligent automation.
Commercial upside. You will evaluate how these capabilities can evolve into scalable, revenue-generating offerings.
How You Will Make An Impact
Strategy & Operating Model
Define the enterprise quality strategy and target operating model across pharmacy and medical.
Establish quality standards, governance, and release-readiness criteria across the lifecycle, in partnership with delivery teams.
Recommend and sequence the operating model with a transition roadmap, metrics, and governance.
Partnership & Governance
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations, and vendors to align on quality expectations and shared accountability.
Provide independent assessments of quality, readiness, and risk to inform executive and delivery decisions.
Strengthen how requirements, UAT, and release readiness work together across organizations.
AI & Automation
Set the AI and automation strategy for quality: predictive analytics, defect prediction, release-risk assessment, and intelligent automation.
Build the business case for investment and quantify impact on quality, speed, and cost.
Establish responsible, auditable AI practices appropriate to a regulated healthcare environment.
Defect Management & Continuous Improvement
Lead enterprise defect management, root-cause analysis, and defect-leakage reduction.
Define quality metrics that measure outcomes and inform decisions.
Build a continuous-improvement engine that raises quality and lowers cost over time.
Vendor Quality & Scalable Delivery
Set quality expectations and accountability for vendor execution, and manage vendor and offshore delivery models toward scalable, multi-customer delivery.
Assess and, if warranted, build quality and testing capabilities into a commercial service offering.
Leadership
Build and lead a high-performing enterprise quality function with clear accountability and metrics.
Communicate credibly at the executive level, translating quality into business impact.
Bring clarity to open-ended problems and lead cross-organizational change.
Scope & Boundaries
This leader owns enterprise quality strategy, standards, and outcomes, and partners closely with the teams who own delivery. The role is designed to work through influence and shared accountability, and how the team is built out will take shape with the leader who steps into it.
Leads: enterprise quality strategy, standards, and governance; quality metrics, defect and root-cause management, and release-readiness criteria; the automation and AI strategy for quality; and an independent view of quality, readiness, and risk.
Partners on: requirements (Product), solution design (Technology), UAT and operational readiness (Operations), and vendor execution; setting quality expectations and driving alignment, while these teams own their own delivery.
The Team You'll Build (Illustrative Starting Point)
This is a starting structure, not a fixed design. The incoming VP will shape how it evolves.
Director, Test Operations: SIT, regression, release testing, defect management, test planning
Director, UAT & Business Validation: Cognizant and customer UAT, business UAT, end-to-end testing readiness
Director, Quality Engineering & Automation: automation, AI-enabled testing, performance testing, frameworks, tooling
Director, Testing Services & Vendor Strategy: vendor management, RFP support, capacity planning, Testing-as-a-Service commercialization
Required Experience
Significant leadership experience in enterprise quality or quality assurance, across in-house and vendor/partner-based delivery.
Demonstrated experience defining and standing up a quality operating model, governance, or transformation at scale across multiple organizations.
Track record of driving quality outcomes through partnership and governance rather than direct ownership of delivery teams.
Strong command of quality metrics, defect management, root-cause analysis, UAT, and release readiness.
Practical experience applying AI/ML and automation to quality, with a clear point of view on where they create value.
Experience managing vendor and offshore delivery models and holding partners accountable to quality standards.
Comfort operating amid ambiguity — defining strategy and structure where none yet exists and leading change.
Executive-level communication that translates quality into business impact.
Healthcare experience, particularly pharmacy claims and PBM; medical claims and health plan experience.
What Sets You Apart
Experience commercializing an internal capability into an external service offering.
Background with large-scale platform migrations and complex, multi-system integration.
P&L or commercial ownership experience.
The Leader We're Looking For
You are a builder and a strategist who thrives when the destination isn't fully mapped. You think in terms of the quality clients and operations actually experience, and you know that depends on many teams working well together — so you lead through partnership and influence rather than control. You are a trusted, independent voice across Product, Technology, Operations, and vendors, and you lead with evidence, metrics, and economics. You see AI and automation as major levers for how quality gets done, and you're motivated by the rare chance to shape a capability that could grow into a commercial business.
Join SS&C, where innovation meets global opportunities. Click here to apply.
Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services.
SS&C Technologies offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and future. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan with company match; paid time off, holidays, and parental leave; and professional development reimbursement opportunity.
Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
SS&C Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of race, color, religious creed, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by applicable discrimination laws.

evidence.text:
Assistant Manager, Manufacturing Process Engineering
American Honda Motor Company, Inc.
Marysville, OH
What Makes a Honda, Is Who Makes a Honda
Honda has a clear vision for the future, and it’s a joyful one. We are looking for individuals with the skills, courage, persistence, and dreams that will help us reach our future-focused goals. At our core is innovation. Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. We strive to be a company that serves as a source of “power” that supports people around the world who are trying to do things based on their own initiative and that helps people expand their own potential. To this end, Honda strives to realize “the joy and freedom of mobility” by developing new technologies and an innovative approach to achieve a “zero environmental footprint.”
We are looking for qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, continuous improvement values, and a strong work ethic to join our team.
If your goals and values align with Honda’s, we want you to join our team to Bring the Future!
Job Purpose
Lead and coordinate New Model associates on daily activity including associate performance. Responsible for total category achievement of A00 targets for each project. Responsible for approving content prior to Product Execution Evaluation. Responsible for workload planning and moving associates to each Project as required. Responsible for Business Plan, Budgeting, Manpower, Safety, Quality, Delivery for all New Model.
Key Accountabilities
Lead the group so that goals and objectives are achieved while supporting all projects. Sets group priorities and assigns the overall work schedule
Associate management – Time entry, Time off approval, HR Policy roll-out / support
Technical Support – Subject matter expert (SME) for the Group. Can do detailed analysis, understands PPH and can set direction for entire Group. Leads complex Manufacturing problem analysis, determine root causes, recommend corrective action.
Workload Balance - Sets group priorities and assigns the overall work schedule. Assure manpower resources to complete Project Targets

Senior Manager - Product Quality Engineering (PQE)
No longer accepting applications
Renesas Electronics
San Jose, CA
Job Description
The Senior Manager PQE is responsible for leading the PQE team, ensuring quality and reliability performance of the assigned products wherever they are designed, manufactured, and assembled, by managing Product Quality related aspects from an end-to-end perspective (from concept throughout the entire product lifecycle) in accordance with international standards and customer requirements. The PQE team is also responsible for Reliability Monitoring through ORT.
Qualifications
Proven track record of successfully leading cross-cultural quality engineering teams, driving organizational performance, talent development, and execution of strategic quality objectives.
Good understanding of semiconductors and the semiconductor industry.
Good understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes (wafer fab, assembly, test).
Strong knowledge on industry quality, reliability standards, and qualification methodologies.
Experience with failure analysis workflows and quality tools (FMEA, 8D, root cause analysis).
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving mindset.
Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams.
Customer-focused, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
Comfortable working in a global, multicultural environment.
Written and verbal English is mandatory.
Flexible to undertake international travel at short notice.
Self-motivated and business service minded.
Excellent interpersonal, organizational and communications skills
Key Responsibilities
Lead and develop the Product Quality Engineering team, providing coaching, performance management, and capability development to ensure organizational success.
Define and execute the product qualification and quality assurance strategy across new product introductions, product changes, supplier changes, and technology transfers.
Ensure effective quality representation throughout the product lifecycle, from design kick-off through production release and sustaining operations.
Establish governance processes to ensure compliance with internal requirements, customer expectations, and applicable industry standards (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949, IEC, JEDEC).
Drive risk management activities, including participation in design and process reviews, and ensure timely implementation and closure of mitigation actions.
Review qualification outcomes, assess quality and reliability risks, and provide final quality approval and recommendations for product release and change management decisions.
Support customer quality engagement related to qualification strategies, reliability performance, and quality-related escalations.
Ensure timely resolution of qualification and product quality issues by driving cross-functional problem-solving, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Partner with Engineering, Operation and Supplier Quality teams to improve product robustness, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
Monitor key quality and reliability metrics, identify emerging risks, and escalate critical issues to management with appropriate mitigation plans.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement (shift-left) by ensuring lessons learned from quality and reliability issues are systematically incorporated into design, process, and organizational improvements.
Manage resource planning, prioritization, and execution of quality objectives to meet business commitments and organizational goals.
Additional Information
Pay Transparency
